scope: exploratory reuse of 4977 development OOF centers in 11 scenario groups; not independent confirmation

cache_contracts.completion: Every original center completed; incomplete/pilot caches rejected
cache_contracts.invalid_rows: Must match locked native-frame validity; invalid cache entries zero; never fit invalid rows

baseline.role: frozen historical five-seed OOF reference and outer-held invalid-input fallback only
baseline.selection_restriction: Baseline probabilities for outer-training rows cannot enter tuning, training, or calibration: their historical OOF estimators may include the current outer-held scenarios
baseline.comparison_limit: P1 uses one seed per arm; historical baseline uses five seeds. Matched new-arm comparisons share P1 budgets.

linear.input: arithmetic mean over all time and spatial-region tokens
linear.standardizer: StandardScaler fit on current inner-training/outer-training valid rows only
linear.inner_selection: pool predictions from valid inner-held rows only; descending three-class macro-F1, ascending NLL, ascending C; no baseline fallback inside selection
linear.convergence: Any convergence warning or estimator n_iter >= max_iter fails closed; no retrospective iteration increase

attentive.loss: temporal_teacher_loss: CE(posture)+CE(motion only on upright examples)
attentive.class_weights: hierarchical_class_weights computed from current outer-training valid rows only
attentive.position_encoding: separate learned time and spatial-region embeddings; spatial cells never interpreted as additional time steps
attentive.selection: fixed final epoch, no early stopping or hyperparameter search

fitting_rules.held_labels: metrics only, never optimization, hyperparameter choice or adaptive stopping
fitting_rules.candidate_budget: three linear C values per arm; one attentive configuration per arm; all five outer folds with seed42
fitting_rules.determinism: seed Python/NumPy/Torch42; deterministic Torch algorithms; CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8 before CUDA initialization; no TF32

statistics.bootstrap: whole-scenario draws, aggregate confusion counts before macro-F1; loss sums before division; condition on retained fitted folds
statistics.paired_comparisons: each of six fitted arm/probe combinations vs fixed baseline; real-vs-repeated and real-vs-DINO within each probe
statistics.multiplicity: Holm across the ten directional macro-F1 comparisons; exploratory only
statistics.error_flow: rescued, harmed, both-correct, both-wrong versus fixed distinct baseline
statistics.reporting: pooled OOF metrics, per-scenario metrics, class support, missing-input fallback counts, all failures and fit/runtime/memory budgets
